name: Surreal
traits: warped scale: giant everyday objects, tiny people
odd objects that behave impossibly but calmly
dreamlike spaces with long shadows and endless floors
clear, quiet light that makes the impossible believable
bestFor: a 'what if' hook that stops the scroll
the moment a product changes how the world feels
mood pieces with one striking image
suits: fragrance, drinks, wellbeing, plant and premium products; curious, poetic, confident brands
stylePara: Painted surrealist animation: an ordinary room rendered with calm, precise oil-painting realism, but its scale and logic are wrong in one clear way at a time, such as a fern taller than the doorway, a window that opens onto a sea, a floor that runs on to a far horizon; long hard shadows from a low late-afternoon sun; smooth matte paint with soft glazes and a fine canvas weave; a clear pale sky and a deep, empty perspective; everyone behaves as if nothing is strange; colours are clean and few, with the product as the brightest object.

rendering.line: no outlines; edges are crisp painted edges with slight softening into shadow
rendering.shading: smooth oil glazes with a clear single light direction and long cast shadows
rendering.colour: a restrained palette of clear sky blues, sand, terracotta and deep greens; the product the most saturated object in frame
rendering.texture: fine canvas weave and smooth glazed paint; no visible brush chaos
rendering.lighting: low, raking late-afternoon sun; long hard shadows; a luminous empty sky

motion: Slow, calm, real-time motion with long holds; impossible things happen smoothly and quietly (an object floats, a room stretches, a shadow points the wrong way) and then hold; one transformation per shot, never a chaotic morph; people move with grounded weight.
camera: Locked wide frames with deep perspective and a low horizon, or one very slow dolly that reveals the scale change; symmetrical compositions; no handheld, no fast cuts.
avoid: chaotic melting morphs of every object
horror distortions of faces or hands
more than one impossible change at once
sheets: Characters in front, three-quarter and side in the calm painted realism, normal proportions; the place as a wide showing the scale rule (what is giant, what is tiny) and a detail view; the product in its exact shape and colours at normal scale and at the shot's warped scale.
risk: Seedance treats 'surreal' as permission to morph everything, which turns faces and the product into melting shapes; name exactly one impossible thing per shot and say 'everything else stays solid and still'. The warped scale also drifts back to normal over a long clip, so state the scale in BLOCKING ('the fern's leaves reach the ceiling, twice her height') and keep clips short.

example.prompt: Painted surrealist still in calm oil realism: a woman in her thirties with a dark bun and an orange top stands holding a small green glass bottle with a yellow cap in a sunny kitchen whose floor runs on to a far horizon; on the windowsill a droopy fern has grown so large its drooping leaves arch over her head and touch the ceiling; long hard late-afternoon shadows, a luminous pale sky through the window, fine canvas weave. Vertical 9:16. No text.
